RigSpecificationsID.title: Rig Specifications ID
RigSpecificationsID.description: Identifies the Rig Specification this Inventory applies to.

RequiredFlowRate.title: Required Flow Rate
RequiredFlowRate.description: Required mud flow rates delivered by the pump system.

SlowCirculationRateDescription.title: Slow Circulation Rates Description
SlowCirculationRateDescription.description:
Description of slow circulation rates (SCR) system.
SCR is the rate at which drilling fluid (mud) is pumped through the wellbore and back to the surface at a deliberately reduced speed.

PowerType.title: Power Type
PowerType.description: The primary energy source used to drive the rig circulation and pressure control equipment (e.g., electric, diesel, diesel‑electric, hydraulic).

BOPPressureRating.title: BOP Pressure Rating
BOPPressureRating.description: The maximum working pressure that the Blowout Preventer (BOP) stack is designed, tested, and certified to safely withstand.

BOPVolume.title: BOP Volume
BOPVolume.description: The total internal fluid capacity of the Blowout Preventer stack, including cavities and flow paths that can contain circulating fluids.

RiserVolume.title: Riser Volume
RiserVolume.description: The total internal fluid capacity of the marine riser or surface riser section between the Blowout Preventer and the rig.

KillLineVolume.title: Kill Line Volume
KillLineVolume.description: The total internal fluid capacity of the fixed kill line between the surface system and the Blowout Preventer kill inlet.

ChokeLineVolume.title: Choke Line Volume
ChokeLineVolume.description: The total internal fluid capacity of the fixed choke line between the Blowout Preventer choke outlet and the choke manifold.

BoostLineVolume.title: Boost Line Volume
BoostLineVolume.description: The total internal fluid capacity of the fixed boost line used to supply additional flow (commonly subsea) to support drilling or circulation operations.

KillLineHoseVolume.title: Kill Line Hose Volume
KillLineHoseVolume.description: The internal fluid capacity of flexible hoses installed in the kill line system.

ChokeLineHoseVolume.title: Choke Line Hose Volume
ChokeLineHoseVolume.description: The internal fluid capacity of flexible hoses installed in the choke line system.

BoosterLineHoseVolume.title: Booster Line Hose Volume
BoosterLineHoseVolume.description: The internal fluid capacity of flexible hoses installed in the booster or boost line system.

CementUnitCementManifoldVolume.title: Cement Unit To Cement Manifold Volume
CementUnitCementManifoldVolume.description: The internal fluid capacity of the flow path between the cement unit discharge and the cement manifold.

CementUnitChokeManifoldVolume.title: Cement Unit To Choke Manifold Volume
CementUnitChokeManifoldVolume.description: The internal fluid capacity of the flow path between the cement unit discharge and the choke manifold.

CementUnitStandpipeManifoldVolume.title: Cement Unit To Standpipe Manifold Volume
CementUnitStandpipeManifoldVolume.description: The internal fluid capacity of the flow path between the cement unit discharge and the standpipe manifold.

MudStandpipeChokeManifoldVolume.title: Mud Standpipe To Choke Manifold Volume
MudStandpipeChokeManifoldVolume.description: The internal fluid capacity of the flow path between the mud standpipe system and the choke manifold.

StandpipeManifoldTopDriveVolume.title: Standpipe Manifold To TopDrive Volume
StandpipeManifoldTopDriveVolume.description: The internal fluid capacity of the flow path between the standpipe manifold and the top drive inlet.

MudPumpsStandpipeManifoldVolume.title: Mud Pumps To Standpipe Manifold Volume
MudPumpsStandpipeManifoldVolume.description: The internal fluid capacity of the flow path between the mud pump discharge and the standpipe manifold.

ChokeManifoldBOPKillVolume.title: Choke Manifold To Blow Out Preventer Kill Volume
ChokeManifoldBOPKillVolume.description: The internal fluid capacity of the flow path between the choke manifold and the BOP kill inlet.

ChokeManifoldBOPChokeVolume.title: Choke Manifold To BlowOut Preventer Choke Volume
ChokeManifoldBOPChokeVolume.description: The internal fluid capacity of the flow path between the choke manifold and the BOP choke outlet or connection.

MudPumpsBOPBoostVolume.title: Mud Pumps To BlowOut Preventer Boost Volume
MudPumpsBOPBoostVolume.description: The internal fluid capacity of the flow path between the mud pump discharge and the BOP boost line inlet.

WellTestStandpipeGooseneckVolume.title: Well Test Standpipe To Gooseneck Volume
WellTestStandpipeGooseneckVolume.description: The internal fluid capacity of the flow path between the well test standpipe and the gooseneck connection used during well testing operations.
